hooks._comment: aide-emit-run links the session to the aide spec it works on (spec 80). Opt-in: set AIDE_RUN_URL to your aide-dashboard's /api/aide-run; empty keeps it inert. install.sh prints a ready-to-paste block with the absolute path.

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [[ "$FILE" == *.md ]]; then npx markdownlint-cli2 "$FILE" 2>&1; fi; exit 0
CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git (.*\s)?add (\.(\s|$)|-A(\s|$))'; then echo 'Blocked: Use explicit file names with git add' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

CMD=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'pnpm test' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q -- '--run'; then echo 'Blocked: Use pnpm test -- --run (not watch mode)' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[ /])vitest($| )' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[ /])vitest run($| )' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q -- '--run'; then echo 'Blocked: Bare vitest starts watch mode - use vitest run' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE -- '--watch( |$|=)|--continuous|cargo watch|(^|[ /])(ptw|pytest-watch)($| )'; then echo 'Blocked: watch mode never exits - use single-run mode' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

hooks.prompt: Check if source code files (.ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs, .py, .go, .rs, .kt, .kts, .java, .rb, .swift, .cs, .php) were edited or written during this turn. If they were, check whether test or type-check commands (pnpm/npm/yarn/bun test, vitest, jest, tsc, pytest, go test, cargo test, gradle/mvn test) were also run in this turn. If code was changed but NO tests or type checks were run, respond with JSON: {"decision": "block", "reason": "<explain which verifications are missing>"}. If no source code was changed (only markdown, config, conversation, git operations), respond with JSON: {"decision": "allow"}. If stop_hook_active is true, always respond with JSON: {"decision": "allow"} to prevent infinite loops. IMPORTANT: Respond with raw JSON only, no markdown, no explanation outside the JSON.
